Parses a standard urlset sitemap

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.mapUrls(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.urls.count)
```
